description: CDISC Biomedical Concepts, published by the Conceptual and Operational Standards Metadata Services (COSMoS): standardized definitions of clinical measurements that a USDM activity can point at, with the field guide and an overview.
version: 2026-07-14, the newest package_date in the export, which is the release date of the most recent Biomedical Concept package it holds. The export itself is rolling, so the pinned commit fixes the copy and this date names the content.

notes.note: The CDISC Library COSMoS API returns 'Members-only content' on this subscription (answer code 401 not permitted), so the Biomedical Concepts (BC) are taken from the public COSMoS repo export instead. The two other files are process references, not data. 'Completion GLs' is the field dictionary for the BC export, and 'Overview Training' is conceptual grounding.
notes.naming_exception: cdisc_biomedical_concepts_latest.xlsx is pinned as cdisc_biomedical_concepts.xlsx, the one departure from keeping the publisher's file name. CDISC's suffix says the file moves. This copy does not, and a pinned file named latest would contradict the pin every time the folder is read. The version is the newest package_date in the export, carried in the folder name. This was decided 2026-09-08, and the version wording was corrected 2026-09-16.

files.name: cdisc_biomedical_concepts_latest.xlsx
files.role: The concept library itself, one row per Biomedical Concept parameter. Answers what standardized concept an activity measures; the code columns carry a Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC) code where the concept is a measurement.

files.name: BC_Curation_Principles_and_Completion_GLs.xlsx
files.path: bc_starter_package/doc/BC Curation Principles and Completion GLs.xlsx
files.role: The field dictionary for the library: what each column means and how CDISC populated it. Read before interpreting a column.

files.name: BC_Overview_Training.pdf
files.role: What a Biomedical Concept is, conceptually, and how it sits above the Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) and the Clinical Data Acquisition Standards Harmonization (CDASH). Grounding only; the searchable PDF, not the slide deck.
